scenario_notes.outage: Assumed application disconnection, not historical exchange evidence. Offline interval [08:55,09:15) Beijing. Funding accrues at exchange; no new decisions or fills during blackout. Discard pending entry on disconnect; reconnect uses a fresh signal.

previous_design.execution: Causal minute model using completed minute for evaluation; entry due +1 minute and fresh funding/cost/sizing recheck; exit due +1 minute as common historical broker approximation. Two-leg same-minute fills assumed. Historical bid/ask absent; trade prices plus adverse slippage and tick rounding proxy. No private API or live orders.
previous_design.rules: Use unchanged production F3 strategy economic pure functions; scheduling is the only F3/G3 difference. Retain daily 09:00 exit review, 168h minimum hold, 24h cooldown, 3 bad days, loss/drawdown/margin/residual limits, neutral treasury. Budget remains capped at min(25, equity).
previous_design.funding: Settled BTC-USD-SWAP rates only, available +1 minute, preceding settlement anchors full 14-day history; no USDT swap funding substitution. Positive funding at exact entry/exit boundary conservatively not credited; negative exit boundary funding charged.
previous_design.mark: Only hourly mark OHLC available. Hour opens are used at exact hour/settlement aliases; intervening completed swap close is a causal proxy. No intra-hour future high/low/close used.
limitations: Public historical price model, not real fills or profitability proof.
Previously researched history, not independent holdout.
